apiMonitor.title: API Monitor
apiMonitor.tagline: Centralized monitoring for usage, cost & availability across 35+ APIs
apiMonitor.description: A NestJS platform with a provider-plugin architecture that polls 35+ external services, tracks usage, cost and quota risk in real time, and pushes alerts. Includes a Next.js dashboard and auto-generated docs.
highlights: Provider plugin system with DI auto-discovery (35+ integrations)
BullMQ + cron pipeline with 3σ anomaly detection
AES-256-GCM encrypted credentials, JWT with refresh rotation
Real-time Socket.IO + multi-channel alerts (FCM / SMTP / Twilio)
apiMonitor.problem: Teams rely on dozens of paid APIs (LLMs, cloud, payments, comms) with no unified view of consumption, cost or quota risk — the surprises only show up on the invoice.
apiMonitor.solution: A NestJS backend with a provider-plugin architecture that polls 35+ services on a schedule, stores usage history and surfaces cost analytics, anomaly alerts and availability in real time, all behind a Next.js dashboard with auto-generated docs.
outcomes: 35+ providers behind one extensible plugin system
Real-time alerts via FCM / SMTP / Twilio + HMAC-signed webhooks
Credentials encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM), never returned to clients
myRole: Designed the provider plugin architecture with DI auto-discovery
Built the BullMQ + cron monitoring pipeline with anomaly detection (3σ)
Implemented AES-256-GCM credential encryption and JWT auth with rotation
Wrote the Next.js admin panel and the auto-generated docs site

nodePermissions.title: node-permissions
nodePermissions.tagline: RBAC library for Node.js, Express & NestJS
nodePermissions.description: Open-source roles & permissions package — wildcard permissions, Express middleware and NestJS guards over TypeORM, with a built-in cache layer. Published to npm under @wagner-labs.
highlights: Wildcard permissions (e.g. articles.*)
Express middlewares + Nest guards & decorators (@Roles / @Permissions)
Configurable cache layer · Jest-tested · VitePress docs
nodePermissions.problem: Node and NestJS apps lack a batteries-included RBAC layer — most teams end up hand-rolling roles & permissions on every project.
nodePermissions.solution: An open-source TypeScript package: roles, direct permissions and wildcards over TypeORM, exposed through Express middleware, NestJS guards/decorators and a configurable cache layer — published to npm with full documentation.
outcomes: Published to npm (@wagner-labs/node-permissions, MIT)
Express + NestJS adapters with wildcard permissions
Jest-tested with VitePress documentation
myRole: Designed and published the package end-to-end
Implemented Express middleware + NestJS guards/decorators (@Roles / @Permissions)
Built the cache layer and TypeORM integration
Wrote VitePress docs and the Jest test suite

tz.q: What time zone do you work in?
tz.a: GMT−3 (Argentina). I overlap easily with EU and Americas teams; async-friendly otherwise. Reply within 24h on business days.

stack.a: NestJS + React / Next.js + PostgreSQL + Docker on AWS or DigitalOcean. Flexible if your project warrants something else — I have shipped Laravel, Vue, Strapi and Flutter in production.

design.a: I work with your designer if you have one. I can ship clean default UIs (like this site) but I won't replace a real product designer for complex products.

equity.a: Usually no — I prefer paid work. Open to discussing for the right founder + project mix.
